incidents.summary: Relocation invariance measurement fails closed — wp5 negative control did NOT flip
incidents.detail: tools/ci/wp5_relocation_measure.nim ran 4 times at this head; every run aborted exit 4: 'negative control did NOT flip the digest (false_post digest == 19660a8eaf3f743762de25f861eacd22fcbfe8970b8ef3ed876ba2fb4043a716)'. The canonical projection digest is not sensitive to the falsified-postcondition mutation of the probe subject, so the harness (by design) refuses to mint pathIndependentProjectionEqual / subjectRunProjectionHashEqual evidence. Both keys honestly ABSENT here → evaluator judges R3 UNKNOWN (fail-closed, never silent PASS). Raw logs: /tmp/wp5_run4.log; workdirs /tmp/axiom_wp5_relocation_*/.
incidents.resolution: Resolved by fix commit 381f08e4f8ac (branch fix/r3-wp5-certified-control): the probe subject was outside the certified-subset wire set (if-expression body = ckIfExpr, rejected in any shape; doc-comment contract parsed by no extractor), so positive and false-post both collapsed to the same NO_ELIGIBLE_OBLIGATION projection. Replaced with the certified-subset subjectProximity (early-return ckIfStmt + non-constant division) whose contract rides the {.axiom: [...]} pragma channel; workdir moved under the repo (gitignored tmp/) so the subject-binding seal measures a resolvable git identity. Measured at two different outer AXIOM_STATE_DIR roots (/tmp/axiom_wp5_outer_a, /tmp/axiom_wp5_outer_b), both exit 0, workingTreeClean=true: digests A=B=A2=commentOnly=0a46b3a282add165…, false_post=6c6b2347f30ef218 (control flips; positive verified by the canonical Lean path, false post lean_kernel_rejected with byte-identical body). pathIndependentProjectionEqual=true, subjectRunProjectionHashEqual=true emitted by the tool itself.
